reason: A DSH Web GUI plugin that monitors OpenCode Go subscription usage through an external API and presents rolling, weekly, and monthly usage with reset countdowns in a floating overlay.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中通过 OpenCode API 显示 OpenCode Go 滚动、周度和月度订阅用量百分比及重置倒计时的悬浮小部件。
summaries.en: A DSH Web GUI floating widget that displays OpenCode Go rolling, weekly, and monthly subscription usage percentages with reset countdowns via the OpenCode API.

capabilities: Displays rolling, weekly, and monthly OpenCode Go usage percentages and reset countdowns in a DSH Web GUI overlay
Periodically requests usage data from the OpenCode API through a server-side proxy
Uses a configured API key resolved by the DSH credential service
Caches usage responses for 60 seconds and refreshes on a timer or when the window regains focus
